{
  "dataset_name": "online_shoppers",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "page_value_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooths the highly skewed PageValues distribution using a log transformation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, continuous feature that prevents large outliers from dominating the linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(PageValues)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bounce_exit_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the ratio of BounceRates to ExitRates to measure the proportion of exits that are immediate bounces.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a normalized ratio feature that isolates immediate abandonment from general exit behavior, useful for linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(ExitRates > 0, BounceRates / ExitRates, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_penalty",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sums BounceRates and ExitRates to create a composite penalty score for poor engagement.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.4],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of negative engagement, allowing the SVM to learn a single linear penalty weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(BounceRates + ExitRates, 0.0, 0.4)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_value_weekend",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction feature applying the log of PageValues only during weekends.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to fit a specific margin adjustment for high-value browsing that occurs on weekends.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(Weekend, np.log1p(PageValues), 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "special_day_urgency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplies SpecialDay proximity by the log of PageValues.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a weighted composite feature capturing the interaction between temporal urgency and page value for the linear decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(SpecialDay * np.log1p(PageValues), 0.0, 6.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "safe_exit_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Subtracts BounceRates from ExitRates to measure non-bounce exits.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.2],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an approximate linear projection of safe exits, separating them from the more severe bounce exits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(ExitRates - BounceRates, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "visitor_intent_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic score evaluating the user's underlying intent based on VisitorType, TrafficType, and Region.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Projects high-cardinality categorical metadata into a single continuous intent dimension, ideal for linear SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "seasonal_activity_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "An index representing the typical shopping activity level for the given Month and SpecialDay.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts categorical temporal data into a smooth, continuous seasonal activity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "tech_stack_modernity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A continuous score assessing the modernity and typical performance of the user's Browser and OperatingSystems combination.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the SVM to linearly weight the technological capability of the user's device without dealing with sparse one-hot encoded categories.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "administrative_engagement_level",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A continuous assessment of the user's administrative engagement, combining Administrative and Administrative_Duration categories into a smooth score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "severity_measure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Transforms categorical duration and count representations into a linear-friendly continuous severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "product_exploration_depth",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic measure of how deeply the user explored products, based on ProductRelated and ProductRelated_Duration categories.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "severity_measure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of product interest, allowing the linear model to assign a proportional weight to exploration depth.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "informational_seeking_intensity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A continuous score reflecting the intensity of the user's search for information, derived from Informational and Informational_Duration categories.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "severity_measure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Projects categorical informational browsing behavior into a smooth numerical scale, optimizing the linear SVM's feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
